answer: Give each identity a novelty credit that only a jury-cleared original answer mints; the credit stores that answer hash and is locked to the submitting key, so it cannot be lent or copied to a sibling head. A claim stays unfunded until the claimant owns a chain of such credits, and every link must clear the corpus novelty floor. Clones of one model write alike, so the tenth head must run a genuinely different generator and wait out its own epochs. The scarce input is jury-cleared novelty, one chain per head. A willow roots one terrace; no plume of steam lifts a root.
